attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

101	func (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		var address, network string
103		if len(s.Profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
104			address = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.Profile.Addr, s.Profile.Port)
105			network = "tcp"
106		} else {
107			address = s.Profile.UNIXSock
108			network = "unix"
109		}
110		listener, err := net.Listen(network, address)
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}
114	
115		if network == "unix" {
116			if err := os.Chmod(address, 0660); err != nil {
117				_ = listener.Close()
118				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to chmod socket")
119			}
120		}
121	
122		// Start Echo server directly (no cmux needed - all traffic is HTTP).
123		s.httpServer = &http.Server{Handler: s.echoServer}
124		go func() {
125			if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {

153	func (s *Server) startBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
154		// Create a separate context for each background runner
155		// This allows us to control cancellation for each runner independently
156		s3Context, s3Cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
157	
158		// Store the cancel function so we can properly shut down runners
159		s.backgroundRunnerCancels = append(s.backgroundRunnerCancels, s3Cancel)
160	
161		// Create and start S3 presign runner
162		s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
163		s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
164	
165		// Start continuous S3 presign runner
166		s.backgroundRunnerWG.Add(1)
167		go func() {
168			defer s.backgroundRunnerWG.Done()
169			s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)
170			slog.Info("s3presign runner stopped")
171		}()
172	
173		slog.Info("background runners started")
174	}

176	func (s *Server) stopBackgroundRunners() {
177		for _, cancelFunc := range s.backgroundRunnerCancels {
178			if cancelFunc != nil {

180			}
181		}
182	}

184	func (s *Server) waitBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
185		done := make(chan struct{})
186		go func() {
187			s.backgroundRunnerWG.Wait()
188			close(done)
189		}()
190	
191		select {
192		case <-done:
193		case <-ctx.Done():
194			select {
195			case <-done:
196				return
197			default:
198			}
199			slog.Error("failed to stop background runners", slog.String("error", ctx.Err().Error()))
200		}
201	}

204		// Long-lived SSE requests do not finish on their own during http.Server.Shutdown.

30	// Constants for file serving configuration.
31	const (
32		// ThumbnailCacheFolder is the folder name where thumbnail images are stored.
33		ThumbnailCacheFolder = ".thumbnail_cache"
34	
35		// MotionCacheFolder is the folder name where extracted motion clips are stored.
36		MotionCacheFolder = ".motion_cache"
37	
38		// thumbnailMaxSize is the maximum dimension (width or height) for thumbnails.
39		thumbnailMaxSize = 600
40	
41		// thumbnailMetadataProbeSize is the maximum number of original image bytes inspected
42		// before thumbnail generation to detect metadata that the JPEG thumbnail pipeline cannot preserve.
43		thumbnailMetadataProbeSize = 1 << 20
44	
45		// maxConcurrentThumbnails limits concurrent thumbnail generation to prevent memory exhaustion.
46		maxConcurrentThumbnails = 3
47	
48		// cacheMaxAge is the max-age value for Cache-Control headers (1 hour).
49		cacheMaxAge = "public, max-age=3600"
50	)

52	// xssUnsafeTypes contains MIME types that could execute scripts if served directly.
53	// These are served as application/octet-stream to prevent XSS attacks.

100	// FileServerService handles HTTP file serving with proper range request support.
101	type FileServerService struct {
102		Profile       *profile.Profile
103		Store         *store.Store
104		authenticator *auth.Authenticator
105	
106		// thumbnailSemaphore limits concurrent thumbnail generation.
107		thumbnailSemaphore *semaphore.Weighted
108	}

110	// NewFileServerService creates a new file server service.
111	func NewFileServerService(profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store, secret string) *FileServerService {
112		return &FileServerService{
113			Profile:            profile,
114			Store:              store,
115			authenticator:      auth.NewAuthenticator(store, secret),
116			thumbnailSemaphore: semaphore.NewWeighted(maxConcurrentThumbnails),
117		}
118	}
119	
120	// RegisterRoutes registers HTTP file serving routes.
121	func (s *FileServerService) RegisterRoutes(echoServer *echo.Echo) {
122		fileGroup := echoServer.Group("/file")
123		fileGroup.GET("/attachments/:uid/:filename", s.serveAttachmentFile)
124		fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)
125	}
126	
127	// =============================================================================
128	// HTTP Handlers
129	// =============================================================================
130	
131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}
166	
167	// serveUserAvatar serves user avatar images.
168	func (s *FileServerService) serveUserAvatar(c *echo.Context) error {
169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}
200	
201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")
203		}
204	
205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208	
209		return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)
210	}
211	
212	// =============================================================================
213	// File Serving Methods
214	// =============================================================================
215	
216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
